2317-2438-6763-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

4452-5256-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.

277-2557-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-3291-7296.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-7296.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2921-6972-7726.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

539-3789-3899-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4455-4779-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4455-4779-7426.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat

413-2388-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-2388-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-2921-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1322-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
1322-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1878-2048-2713-3454-4539.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2048-2713-3454-4539.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Epitaph Golem twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

325-2428-4444-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2428-4444-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

4050-4094-4770-6090.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4050-4094-4770-6090.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

2486-5256--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the persist creature's power.
Repeat.

3946-4935-5155.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1298-3368-4050-4280.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting the spell.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of the spell it was targeting and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Veyran triggers twice, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing the six Phyrexian Goblins, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1030-2034-2062-4831.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-2062-4831.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cacophodon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Cacophodon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cacophodon enters the battlefield, triggering Marauding Raptor, dealing 2 damage to Cacophodon and giving Marauding Raptor +2/+0 until end of turn.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

839-1430-1849-2105-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five modified creatures.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
839-1430-1849-2105-5256.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Combat Celebrant.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Mirror Image and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Mirror Image as it attacks.
Mirror Image triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mirror Image, causing target player to mill cards equal to Mirror Image's power.
Repeat.

1339-1385-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1385-1832-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2232-2459-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters. Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2179-2585-3263.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {4}.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Grim Monolith's last ability.
Resolve the copy of Grim Monolith's last ability, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Grim Monolith ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

168-1462-2686-4129.notablePrerequisites: You do not have any other cards in hand.
168-1462-2686-4129.description:
On opponent's end step before your turn, cast Back to Nature by paying {1}{G}, destroying all enchantments.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Barren Glory from exile to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
